text:
Mika (DB): deploybot kicked off MIG-278 on prod — acquired exclusive lock on schema.orders, starting backfill wave 1. ETA ~12m. Pausing other write-heavy jobs. @Raja can you hold feature flag orders_export_v2?
deploybot: MIG-278 started by Mika. Canaries 3/3 healthy. Holdpoint: none. Release notes draft: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/MIG-278
Raja: Holding flag orders_export_v2 now. watching QPS.
Lenore: Heads-up — we should mention the column rename in customer-facing notes (could affect a small # of integrations). I'll add a note.
Mika (DB): Requesting a brief pause to insert a manual_unpin holdpoint — saw kv-cache eviction anomaly on canary with runtime v1.3.2. Prefer to pin to v1.3.1 for this migration to avoid regen.
Sam (oncall): Ok to pause. We need a fallback decision: if exclusive lock > 5m, rollback vs continue? I suggest fallback to online index/apply path if lock waiters spike.
Raja: +1 for pause. @deploybot can you insert a manual_unpin holdpoint and pause the job until we verify unpin on a single shard?
deploybot: holdpoint inserted: manual_unpin at 1791234578. MIG-278 paused by Mika.
Mika (DB): Running test unpin on shard-3 now. If green will unpause. SQL I'm running:
```
-- online-safe rename, low impact
ALTER TABLE orders RENAME COLUMN old_id TO archived_old_id;
```
Lenore: Updated release notes: added "Temporary runtime pinning for migration MIG-278" and "possible brief unavailability of order-export". Pinged docs owner to stage the blurb.
Sam (oncall): I'll set lock-wait alert to 4s and monitor rows/sec/replica-lag. If waiters > 3, we abort and rollback.
deploybot: MIG-278 resumed by Mika at 1791234590. Holdpoint manual_unpin cleared.
Raja: Flag orders_export_v2 released. All checks green :thumbsup:
Mika (DB): Migration completed, no rollback needed. Will file a short blameless note in #postmortems and attach timings/metrics. Thanks everyone!
